messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: paged oncall @oncall-rosa for elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate. Automated severity: P1. See metrics: https://metrics.redwood.example/charts/5xx-surge

oncall-rosa: I'm on it. seeing 5xx spike around 12:05 UTC, error signature looks like SIGABRT from allocator in model-runner.

sre-max: Dumping recent logs from runtime on gpu-pool-6: `model-runner[pid=2345]: malloc: assertion failed: arena.c:452: abort()` then segfault. Also a couple of OOM kills on node gpu-node-6b.

eng-runtime-lee: thanks. correlation with a new quant kernel landed 18m ago to 6 nodes. rolling back patch now. starting drain on pool gpu-pool-6 to prevent new allocations.

oncall-rosa: @eng-runtime-lee what's the rollback command?

eng-runtime-lee: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/model-runner model-runner=registry/redwood/model-runner:stable-20250301` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner -n inference --selector=pool=gpu-pool-6`

infra-ops-sam: I'm isolating the three nodes that reported allocator aborts (gpu-node-6b, gpu-node-6c, gpu-node-6d) and marking them unschedulable. scaling up spare nodes now.

support-jordan: Any idea on customer impact? we already have alerts from one customer workspace reporting 502s. Customer ID: cw-8821, high-traffic.

product-amy: Flagging potential impact to enterprise customers on dedicated clusters. adding to incident slack channel #enterprise-watchlist.

eng-runtime-lee: Live mitigation plan: 1) remove patched kernel variant from routing for now (router rule change) 2) roll back model-runner images on affected pools 3) restart workers one-at-a-time to avoid cold-cache storm 4) enable fallback model variant (q4f -> q2a) for sensitive routes to reduce allocation pressure

oncall-rosa: executed step 1: router rule updated to route new traffic away from kernel=opt-qkernel-1.

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager duty escalation sent to SRE primary @sre-max and ENG runtime lead @eng-runtime-lee.

sre-max: I'm SSHing into gpu-node-6b to capture coredump. attaching gdb stack:
```
#0  0x00007f6b7c12ab4d in raise () from /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
#1  0x00007f6b7c12c862 in abort () from /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
#2  0x00007f6b7c130a8f in malloc_printerr () from /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
#3  0x00007f6b6d2a3f7b in allocator_arena_alloc ()
#4  0x000055b6f1a2c9d4 in model_alloc_tensor at model_allocator.c:128
```

eng-runtime-lee: that stack aligns with a bad path in the new fused-kernel allocator. I'm halting all deployment of that kernel and triggering a canary rollback across all pools.

infra-ops-sam: nodes drained and cordoned: gpu-node-6b,c,d. spindown of pods done. provisioning 3 replacement nodes in eu-west-1.

support-jordan: cw-8821 reports intermittent 502s resumed at 12:22 after initial spike. still receiving ~200 errors/min across a few workspaces.

oncall-rosa: estimate: partial customer impact for ~17 minutes, primary affected routes: /v1/generate and streaming websocket endpoints. Notifying account teams.

product-amy: please add timeline to incident doc. I'll coordinate external comms if we need an SLA note.

eng-runtime-lee: mitigation status update: rolled back fused-kernel on all pools (started 12:14, complete 12:34). Restarted runners with staggered 30s delay to avoid batch cold start spike. Enabled fallback q2a variant on `/v1/generate` for tenants with >1M tokens/day.

incident-bot: METRICS: 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 1.2% over 10 minutes after rollback. Latency shows a transient 200ms increase for affected tenants.

sre-max: captured heap profile from one crashed runner: `malloc_stats: inuse: 4.8GB, total: 6.2GB` suspicious bump in temporary KV cache allocations when using fused-kernel path.

eng-runtime-lee: root cause hypothesis: allocator path in fused-kernel introduced a race condition causing double-free/abort under high concurrent streaming sessions. patch revert plus adding an allocator-fallback path to jemalloc fixes.

infra-ops-sam: reimaged gpu-node-6b/c/d and rejoined to pool 12:58. Nodes stable.

support-jordan: Logged impacted customer CW-8821 and CW-9923. CS outreach in progress. No escalations yet.

oncall-rosa: current status: all traffic routed to stable kernels, cordoned nodes replaced, 5xxs returned to baseline. moving to post-incident review. Can someone create the incident doc with timeline/action items?

product-amy: I'll create the external incident summary draft. @eng-runtime-lee and @sre-max please add technical appendix.

eng-runtime-lee: follow-ups: add stricter preflight for allocator kernels (load-test with streaming qps), add allocator sanitizers, add automated router rollback on SIGABRT patterns.

sre-max: I'll run a full forensic on coredumps and push a hotfix for allocator guard checks.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. next update scheduled in 30m.

oncall-rosa: thanks team — handing back to SRE rotation. Closing pager. :thumbsup:
